reason: Reader-only descriptions remove generation instructions and unsupported visibility/success assertions. Frozen briefs and artwork are unchanged.

caption.source: Open dry bridge deck leads directly to a large unmarked lift door. A single cyan strip beneath the bench marks its available charge; only two simple socket recesses.
caption.display: A dry bridge deck leads to a lift door. A cyan strip beneath the bench indicates its available charge.

caption.source: Continuous deck remains visible between two stout handrails; the loose cable crosses the far end. A small hard cyan contact glow on the broken cable identifies the electrical hazard without concealing the walkway.
caption.display: A loose electrical cable crosses a bridge deck between handrails. A cyan glow marks the damaged contact.

caption.source: Wide uncluttered stone floor connects the stair opening and oven mouth. A simple vertical mill shaft beside the oven connects visibly to the sail's one thick rope.
caption.display: A rooftop oven and mill share power from the neighborhood sail above them.

caption.source: A single narrow fixed plank joins the ledges; both landing points remain readable. A slack heavy sail threatens to sweep across the plank; no dense airborne debris.
caption.display: A fixed plank connects two roof ledges. A slack sail threatens to sweep across the crossing.

caption.source: A clear flat aisle parallels a single embedded rail and leads to a small clinic doorway. One shallow rust trough contains dark compost beside the tree; fruit remains clustered in large simple masses.
caption.display: An orchard loading aisle follows an embedded rail toward a clinic. A rust trough holds compost beside a fruit tree.

caption.source: A pale maintenance shelf remains visible along one bank. Heat softens a single rail across the route; isolate the glow to the pool, no sparks filling the view.
caption.display: A maintenance shelf follows the bank of a slag pool. Heat has softened a rail across the route.

caption.source: Dry white floor runs from the broad entrance to the counter. Three large unlettered document bundles sit in separate drying slots; pink tabs are the only color.
caption.display: An archive entrance leads to an intake counter with separate drying slots for document bundles.

caption.source: One raised maintenance strip leads between shelves to the door. The lowest shelf sags into the water; floating pages gather in one distinct raft, no wallpaper of small text.
caption.display: A raised maintenance strip runs between flooded shelves. A sagging shelf releases pages into the water.

caption.source: A wide descending lane ends in a clearly flat red stopping strip. One empty simple two-wheel freight cart sits parked away from the lane; no crowd or text.
caption.display: A descending freight practice lane ends in a red stopping strip, with an empty cart parked nearby.

caption.source: The lane's two continuous edges show its downhill bend and final flat stopping pocket. One cracked rubber brake slab has lifted at the curve's exit; no cliffs or extra track forks needed.
caption.display: A downhill lane bends toward a stopping pocket. A cracked rubber brake slab has lifted at the exit.

caption.source: A wide dry ledge runs around the bath directly to a plain door. A thin steam ribbon rises only where the pipe enters the water; the hall is a public utility, not a decorated palace.
caption.display: A neighborhood warming bath has a surrounding service ledge and a pipe feeding hot water into the pool.

caption.source: The balcony connects a stair landing to one visible bell support socket. A single large crack runs from the bell lip upward; its displaced lip hangs close to the service route.
caption.display: A service balcony links a stair landing to a bell support. A crack in the bell leaves its displaced lip hanging near the route.

caption.source: The stair clearly joins the open court and a raised doorway; no split routes. A single broad mint adjustment socket appears on the lowest step, large enough to understand at a glance.
caption.display: An adjustable stair connects an open court to a raised doorway. A mint-colored socket marks the lowest step.

caption.source: A single temporary wood bridge joins the slabs with both ends fully supported and visible. One arch foot has lifted out of its stone bed, leaving a clean readable vertical gap beside the route.
caption.display: A temporary wooden bridge joins shifted slabs. An arch foot has lifted out of its stone bed beside the crossing.

caption.source: A wide orange-earth path passes between stove and tree toward an open shelter door. One empty oversized rain bowl sits on the wall beneath the tree's drip edge.
caption.display: An orchard kitchen path runs between a stove and a fruit tree toward a shelter. A rain bowl sits beneath the tree.

caption.source: A broad stepped service path winds once around the tower to a low access hatch. One torn orange sail hangs across the path; a single dark storm mass approaches from the exposed side.
caption.display: A stepped service path winds around a windmill tower. A torn sail blocks the route as a storm approaches.

caption.source: A clear pale floor leads straight from a plain doorway to the counter. One tightly bound bundle of dormant black reeds lies on the counter; no jars or flowers filling every shelf.
caption.display: A winter dye exchange has a plain counter holding a bound bundle of dormant black reeds.

caption.source: A narrow pale service aisle runs beside the bed to a visible closed metal door. One split planting-bed corner shows thick black roots pressing outward; red condensate runs in one stain, no gore or luminous fog.
caption.display: A service aisle runs beside a forced-growth planting bed. Roots press through a split corner, with red condensate staining the bed.
